echo "=== try specific pinned minio tags on docker hub ==="; for t in RELEASE.2024-01-01T00-00-00Z RELEASE.2025-01-01T00-00-00Z; do timeout 40 docker pull minio/minio:$t 2>&1 | tail -1; done
echo "=== GHCR ==="; timeout 40 docker pull ghcr.io/minio/minio:latest 2>&1 | tail -2
echo "=== minio github release assets ==="; curl -sSL -m 30 https://api.github.com/repos/minio/minio/releases?per_page=2 2>&1 | grep -E '"tag_name"|"browser_download_url".*linux-amd64' | head
